title: Is That Thing Off
gist_ar: مشهد بيتغيّر فيه المستوى اللغوي تمامًا لما التسجيل يقف.

before_listening.en: The same event, described twice. Listen for what changes when the recorder stops.
before_listening.ar: نفس الحدث بيتوصف مرتين. ركّز على إيه اللي يتغيّر لما التسجيل يقف.

segments.speaker: Interviewer
segments.text: Ms Farid, could you outline for us the rationale behind the decision to withdraw the product?

segments.speaker: Ms Farid
segments.text: Certainly. Following a routine review, we concluded that the product no longer aligned with our long-term strategic priorities, and we took the decision to discontinue it in an orderly manner.

segments.speaker: Interviewer
segments.text: And the reports of a safety concern?

segments.speaker: Ms Farid
segments.text: I'm not in a position to comment on speculation.

segments.speaker: Interviewer
segments.text: Thank you. Right, that's us — Ahmed, you can put that down.

segments.speaker: Ms Farid
segments.text: Right. Look — between us, the whole thing fell apart. Not the product, the process. We'd been putting the review off for a year and a half because nobody fancied being the one to bring it up, and then someone finally did, and it turned out we'd all been quietly assuming somebody else had checked. Nobody had.

segments.speaker: Ms Farid
segments.text: It's a much worse answer, which is exactly why you got the other one. I'm not going to be the woman who says 'nobody had checked' on camera.

segments.speaker: Interviewer
segments.text: You know the strategic-priorities line is what everyone will run.

segments.speaker: Ms Farid
segments.text: Of course they'll run it. It's clean, it's short, nobody has to ring me back. And in eighteen months when somebody digs it up and puts it next to the review, I'll be the one explaining why I said it. I know exactly what I've bought and what it cost.

segments.speaker: Interviewer
segments.text: Will you pull the next one earlier?

segments.speaker: Ms Farid
segments.text: We'll see. Ask me in a year and I'll give you a sentence you can use.

segments.speaker: Interviewer
segments.text: One more, off the record. Do you regret the line?

segments.speaker: Ms Farid
segments.text: No. I regret that it's the one that works. Those are different regrets, and only one of them is mine to fix.

segments.speaker: Ms Farid
segments.text: You won't. It's got a subordinate clause in it.

gist_question.q: What changes when the recorder stops?
gist_question.q_ar: إيه اللي يتغيّر لما التسجيل يقف؟
options: She contradicts what she said on the record
She gives the same event in a register that names what actually happened
She refuses to discuss it further

questions.q: Why does she call the honest answer 'much worse'?
options: Because it is untrue and she would be lying to the public if she ever said it
Worse for her, which is why the formal line was given instead

questions.q: What does she say about the strategic-priorities line?
options: She expects it to be forgotten
She knows it may be used against her later and accepts that cost
She believes it is the accurate explanation

questions.q: What does 'nobody fancied being the one to bring it up' mean?
questions.q_ar: إيه معنى 'محدش كان نفسه يكون هو اللي يفتح الموضوع'؟
options: Nobody wanted to be the person who raised it
Nobody on the team actually understood the safety issue that was involved
